table:columns.name: IncidentDate
table:columns.description: Date the incident was reported/recorded by SLMPD.

table:columns.name: OccurredFromTime
table:columns.description: Date/time the offense began (NIBRS incidents record an occurred-from time).

table:columns.name: IncidentNum
table:columns.description: SLMPD incident (complaint) number; multiple offense rows can share one incident.

table:columns.name: Offense
table:columns.description: SLMPD's Missouri statutory offense description for the charge (e.g. 'MURDER 1ST DEGREE', 'STEALING - MOTOR VEHICLE').

table:columns.name: NIBRS
table:columns.description: FBI NIBRS offense code for the offense, e.g. 09A Murder/Nonnegligent Manslaughter, 13A Aggravated Assault, 23G Theft of Motor Vehicle Parts, 240 Motor Vehicle Theft, 290 Destruction/Damage/Vandalism (FBI NIBRS offense code list).

table:columns.name: NIBRSCategory
table:columns.description: FBI NIBRS offense category name corresponding to the NIBRS code (e.g. 'Motor Vehicle Theft', 'Aggravated Assault').

table:columns.name: SRS_UCR
table:columns.description: Legacy FBI Summary Reporting System (SRS/UCR) Part I offense class for the offense: 01 Criminal Homicide, 02 Rape, 03 Robbery, 04 Aggravated Assault, 05 Burglary, 06 Larceny-Theft, 07 Motor Vehicle Theft, 08 Arson (null for non-Part-I offenses).

table:columns.name: CrimeAgainst
table:columns.description: NIBRS 'Crimes Against' classification of the offense: Person, Property, or Society (FBI NIBRS groups every offense this way); 'Unspecified' appears for some records.

table:columns.name: FelMisdCit
table:columns.description: Charge-severity flag: F felony, M misdemeanor, with C and I also present (per the column name 'Fel/Misd/Cit' C is presumably citation and I infraction; SLMPD publishes no decode).

table:columns.name: IncidentTopSRS_UCR
table:columns.description: SRS/UCR class of the most serious offense in the incident (the SRS hierarchy rule reports only the highest offense; inferred from the field name and the SRS hierarchy convention).

table:columns.name: IncidentLocation
table:columns.description: Street address or block-level location of the incident.

table:columns.name: IntersectionOtherLoc
table:columns.description: Intersection or other non-address location description for the incident.

table:columns.name: District
table:columns.description: SLMPD police district number where the incident occurred.

table:columns.name: Neighborhood
table:columns.description: City neighborhood name of the incident location; NbhdNum is the corresponding neighborhood number (1-79 per the city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary).

table:columns.name: IncidentSupplemented
table:columns.description: Yes/No — whether the incident record has been supplemented (updated) since the original report.

table:columns.name: LastSuppDate
table:columns.description: Date of the most recent supplement to the incident record.

table:columns.name: VictimNum
table:columns.description: Victim record identifier assigned by SLMPD (an ID shared by rows describing the same victim, not a count of victims — verified against the data).

table:columns.name: FirearmUsed
table:columns.description: Whether a firearm was used in the offense.

table:columns.name: IncidentNature
table:columns.description: Nature-of-incident text as recorded by SLMPD.

table:columns.name: keep
table:columns.description: Flag added by this mirror's pipeline: true when the record had valid coordinates falling inside the city boundary (geometry is null when false).

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>
